title: One checked pass covers many idle lanes at archive, without weakening the records-landed check
why: Guard lane-closes-after-records needs a get_session of each target, alone in its own turn, before each archive_session, and refuses when gh cannot read the lane's branches. Archiving 35 idle lanes costs 70 turns (coordinator, 10:27 CST Nov 12).
source: coordinator 10:27 and 10:28 CST Nov 12; lane archive-flow
note: Idea (lane archive-flow): `merge --idle-lanes` already reads each lane's records-landed state (steps landed, no open PR, no open page item, handoff flag). The guard accepts a lane named in a fresh, unflagged idle-lanes list as its check, in place of its own get_session turn; the stranded-branch read stays. A guard change: test-author red cases first, builder, reviewer, review cap three; the guard's pinned gh call counts re-point red then green. Home: merge --idle-lanes (rule building-one-home-per-capability). Coordinator 10:28 CST: build it in lane archive-flow after the list-flag PR is handed in; 35 idle lanes wait on it. Open design points: how the guard proves the list is fresh without a new file or timer; a list read in the guard costs one run of the idle-lanes reader per archive batch. Coordinator 10:30 CST Nov 12: any archive/ ref whose tip contains a branch tip covers that branch. Red case: the same tip under another archive name, hit live on lane batch-build-check-change-alone at 10:29 CST. Lane archive-flow wrote this record itself through the GitHub file tool (b10482fb2); triage took it over (step roadmap-write-via-github-tool).
